invariants: Payment or funded milestone alone does not make a project ready to build
BUILDING must not start before scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies and required access are ready
Missing customer dependency produces CLIENT_ACTION_REQUIRED rather than silently consuming delivery time
Material customer-caused dependency delay requires schedule or ETA rebaseline before a new commitment is made
Credentials and secrets must not be collected through ordinary onboarding documents
Customer owner and LD owner must both be identified before kickoff
Communication channel and decision path must be explicit
Kickoff does not authorize Production deployment or any consequential release action
Unknown or contradictory readiness evidence returns NOT_READY or review
